about: The founder's 60 journeys (JOURNEY-SPECS.md, 2026-09-25, card t_18f80a89) mapped to the catalogue examples that show the moment each spec's success check describes. A journey is covered only when an example shows the success-check moment itself, not an earlier step or a related shape; otherwise it has examples [] and a section in catalogue/gaps/journeys.md. What happens outside the chat (a mail arriving, a phone notification, the live view, a calendar updating) is not a card; the note says so where the check depends on it. Checked by scripts/check-journeys.mjs.

journeys.title: Research and compare products
journeys.note: No example links each compared product: rows carry no link, and the one URL on shop-marketplaces-compare is a Lazada search. See catalogue/gaps/journeys.md.

journeys.title: Buy an item end to end
journeys.note: The order placed after the approval, with the amount paid and the merchant's confirmation as the source.

journeys.title: Build a cart for the user to finish
journeys.note: Every item in the person's own FairPrice cart, with the check-out link; nothing is ordered.

journeys.title: Track orders and deliveries
journeys.note: Every tracking example is one order; none answers 'what's arriving?' with two or more orders. See catalogue/gaps/journeys.md.

journeys.title: Returns and return deadlines
journeys.note: The return deadline per order, then the return requested, received and refunded.

journeys.title: Price-drop and restock watch
journeys.note: The price watch set, and a price watch that fired with the old and new price (a hotel rate).

journeys.title: Negotiate a price / haggle
journeys.note: home-negotiate-offer is the opening offer before approval; no example shows the approved message sent. See catalogue/gaps/journeys.md.

journeys.title: Trip research and itinerary
journeys.note: travel-itinerary has dated days but no flight or hotel prices or links. See catalogue/gaps/journeys.md.

journeys.title: Find and compare flights
journeys.note: Direct options with fares as of a time, the fare site as the source, one pick.

journeys.title: Book a flight
journeys.note: Booked after approval with the approved total and the e-ticket.

journeys.title: Find and book a hotel
journeys.note: The hotel booking with ref, total and the confirmation.

journeys.title: Trip logistics from booking emails
journeys.note: No example builds an itinerary from booking mails or adds the trip's events to the calendar. See catalogue/gaps/journeys.md.

journeys.title: Watch fares / hotel rates, rebook on drop
journeys.note: travel-rate-drop-rebook asks to rebook; no example shows the one booking left at the lower price. See catalogue/gaps/journeys.md.

journeys.title: Airport ride timed to the flight
journeys.note: book-airport-ride proposes the pickup before booking and travel-flight-status has nothing to change; no booked ride or delay reschedule. See catalogue/gaps/journeys.md.

journeys.title: Restaurant reservation

journeys.title: Doctor / dentist appointment

journeys.title: Hair / beauty / wellness booking
journeys.note: A salon booked by phone: the agreed time and the transcript.

journeys.title: Government / DMV appointment
journeys.note: The confirmation after the person's own Singpass (or DMV) step: office, time and the government reference, with the calendar event. The final-submit take-over itself is the live view, not a card.

journeys.title: Event tickets
journeys.note: Two tickets bought with the approved total and the e-tickets.

journeys.title: Reschedule or cancel a booking
journeys.note: The cancellation with the venue's confirmation and the deposit refund.
